question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

TIMID
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Courageous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of "**timid**" is "**courageous**."
 
• **Timid **implies a lack of courage or confidence,
 
• **Courageous **means having or showing bravery, fearlessness, or boldness.(साहसी)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Courageous'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SMELLY: **It refers to having an unpleasant or offensive odor.(दुर्गंधित)
 
• **LUCID:** clear, easily understandable, or rational.(सुस्पष्ट) 
 
• **CAREFUL:** Exercising caution, being attentive, or taking precautions.(सतर्क)
